name: L10 PanoLab fresh target-way/image-disjoint active lexical panel
question: Can a metadata-only rule freeze four previously unused named target ways and provider-linked occluded-to-DIRECT frame pairs across multiple cities for a fresh Development test of the track lexical consensus mechanism?

selection_rule.eligibility: Require a named target way unused by the prior four active episodes; both item IDs absent from that source and the prior local Panoramax image directory; reciprocal same-sequence provider adjacency; 3-15 metre motion; metadata geometry transition from target/other-building occluded to DIRECT; 4-40 metre after-frame entrance range; and both items passing the unchanged strict orientation gate.
selection_rule.within_target_way: Choose the pair by ascending significant target-name token count, after entrance distance, sequence ID, start item ID, after item ID.
selection_rule.panel: Group the chosen target-way pairs by source city; within city sort by significant target-name token count, after entrance distance, target-way ID and sequence ID; select round-robin over city name order while requiring unique sequence IDs until four episodes are frozen.
forbidden_inputs: selected full, SD, thumbnail, or tile pixels
human portal or sign visibility judgment

materialization.download_rule: Only after the selection output exists; refuse existing destination or stale temporary; verify exact full-sensor 2:1 dimensions; record URL, bytes and SHA-256.

claim_boundary.allowed: A fresh target-way-, item-, and prior-active-sequence-disjoint Development roster selected without viewing its pixels or model outputs.
not_allowed: access, traversability, waypoint, arrival, HANDOFF_READY, user benefit, deployment performance, or safety
